MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "It's Entertainment feels like a natural next listen because I want an upbeat vocal album after The New Old Fashioned.",
    "Christmas Voices connects with my repeated Christmas listening, though I would save it for the holiday season."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Music of SMASH and Stages do not match a current interest in shows or stage music; wanting vocals does not mean I want a soundtrack.",
    "Sacred Spirit Drums does not fit my current preference for vocals, while Wow Hits 2015 feels too broad when I want a focused album.",
    "Chloe, Heritage, Time To Say Goodbye, and Wicked Game give me too little connection to my recent listening to motivate me to try them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Christmas listening seems to have been treated as an interest I would act on throughout the year.",
    "My interest in vocal albums seems to have been stretched to include stage music and soundtracks without evidence that I want those experiences."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest choice, The New Old Fashioned, matters more to what I want now than the cluster of Christmas albums I explored earlier.",
    "I rarely explore recommendations unless there is a clear connection to what I want, so a loosely related title is not enough to draw me in."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in vocal and Christmas albums but missed the difference between an upbeat listen now and holiday music for later."
}
